name: Mystragedy
source:
Five years ago there was a murder that never got solved.
But same type murder happens again now. As main character begins his investigation, he gets infatuated with an intelligent girl of surprising identity...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
五年前发生了一起始终未能侦破的谋杀案。
如今，同类型的案件再次出现。主人公展开调查后，逐渐迷恋上一名聪明、身份却出人意料的女孩…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
